scope: Additional D18–D19, preserving prior D01–D17; no assertion of dark energy nonexistence

entries.objects: GR metric, matter action, global 4-volume constraints or auxiliary 4-form fields
entries.transitions: vacuum-loop contributions to curvature cancel by variation/constraint, leaving radiatively stable residual
entries.emerges: explains why large matter vacuum energy need not gravitate as naive Λ; not a complete origin of cosmic acceleration
entries.inputs: metric geometry, quantum matter, action, global/auxiliary constraints, residual Λ measured
entries.transfer: test difference between local generative rule and globally constrained effective observable; do not add force
entries.loss: original formulation requires compact spacetime/recollapse; local variant adds auxiliary fields and does not predict residual Λ value
entries.verification: published 2014 PRL and 2016 local reformulation abstract checked

entries.family: Unimodular gravity and Λ integration constant (Unruh 1989)
entries.objects: metric gravitational geometry plus prescribed spacetime volume element
entries.transitions: variation with determinant/volume constraint yields Λ as integration constant
entries.emerges: changes parameter status of apparent dark-energy term, not necessarily observed magnitude
entries.inputs: nondynamic background volume element and GR fields
entries.transfer: benchmark distinction between integration constant and derived emergent parameter
entries.loss: original paper itself notes background volume element and initial-condition small-Λ gap
